description_fr: Adobe est un editeur americain de logiciels qui propose des plateformes et outils de creativite, de productivite et d'orchestration de l'experience client, en grande majorite par abonnement. Son activite Digital Media regroupe Creative Cloud (creation visuelle et video), Document Cloud (Acrobat et signature) et Adobe Express, tandis que le segment Digital Experience adresse les entreprises via Experience Cloud (donnees et marketing client). A partir de l'exercice 2026, Adobe organise son reporting autour de deux groupes clients : Professionnels et Particuliers, et Creatifs et Marketing. La societe deploie une gamme de produits d'intelligence artificielle generative et agentique, dont la marque Firefly.
description_en: Adobe is a US software company that provides creativity, productivity, and customer experience orchestration platforms and tools, predominantly on a subscription basis. Its Digital Media business comprises Creative Cloud (visual and video creation), Document Cloud (Acrobat and e-signature), and Adobe Express, while the Digital Experience segment serves enterprises through Experience Cloud (customer data and marketing). Starting in fiscal 2026, Adobe organizes its reporting around two customer groups: Business Professionals & Consumers, and Creative & Marketing Professionals. The company is rolling out a range of generative and agentic artificial intelligence products, including the Firefly brand.
